name: DS_ARA_CACHE
meaning: the cache folder the plugin writes below (default ~/Library/Caches/DrumSpike/ARA)

name: DS_ARA_OUT
meaning: where the plugin writes its report, one JSON object per line

name: DS_ARA_DEPS
meaning: check.sh only: the folder of the third-party parts (default .deps)

name: DS_ARA_TESTHOST
meaning: check.sh only: the ARATestHost binary of the conformance stage

name: DS_ARA_FAULT
meaning: the analysis runs inside process on purpose, so the overrun check can fail

name: DS_ARA_TABLES_FAULT
meaning: the plugin serves a document controller table with one emptied slot

name: DS_ARA_RESTORE_FAULT
meaning: the restore decodes one source, ignores the stored id, drops the stored events, or sets the events of the document on the worker thread

name: DS_ARA_SERVICE_FAULT
meaning: a new service for every job (the M1a way)

name: DS_ARA_TRACKS_FAULT
meaning: a later request forgets the earlier tracks

name: DS_ARA_FOLDER_FAULT
meaning: every document uses one folder

name: DS_ARA_DESTROY_FAULT
meaning: a destroyed source stays in the list and the project

name: DS_ARA_HOME_FAULT
meaning: the service home is below the user's home, outside the cache folder

name: DS_ARA_ROUND_FAULT
meaning: a round analyses only the new tracks, a request for a complete source starts a full round, a request waits for ever for audio that does not come, or audio that comes after the deadline starts no round

name: DS_ARA_SETTLE_FAULT
meaning: no settle time: every request is a round

name: DS_ARA_CLOSE_FAULT
meaning: the destroy of a controller waits for the round, or does not cancel it

name: DS_ARA_ID_FAULT
meaning: the plugin trusts the document id and the track names of an archive, and the names of the host sources

name: DS_ARA_REGISTRY_FAULT
meaning: no registry of the document ids in use: two live documents may share one

name: DS_ARA_ERRORS_FAULT
meaning: the error of a single track is not read

name: DS_ARA_RETRY_FAULT
meaning: a retried source makes a second track

name: DS_ARA_TOUCH_FAULT
meaning: a change of the regions or the properties of a source is not seen, or a move in playback time alone starts a round

name: DS_ARA_GUARD_FAULT
meaning: the reader thread and the worker thread run without the panic guard

name: DS_ARA_UNLOAD_FAULT
meaning: the unload of the library does not stop the worker

name: DS_ARA_PANIC_TEST
meaning: the reader thread or the worker thread panics once

name: DS_ARA_SCENARIO
meaning: the WAV of source n is damaged after the read, the first round fails once, every round waits 1.5 s before its analysis starts, or a request waits n ms for audio (default 30000)
